items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I've known Dave so many, many, many years. ... One of the finest men that I've met in my life.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. That's all I wanted. I wanted... I just wanted clearance on it. Oh, sure. Well, I can understand. The union has always given us permission. Dave has always been very cooperative. I think Dave is very intelligent.
Dave is one of the finest men, you know. He lost the election on an international board member, vice president of the international union. He lost that.
They stole a march on him, I heard. Sure. They really got him.
